paper1_text: We implemented our system as a web application using SvelteKit. For sentence retrieval, we used WeaviateDB as our vector database, using its built-in text embedding capabilities and approximate k-Nearest Neighbor (kNN) search implementation [34]. The system was deployed on a workstation with 12 GB of GPU memory and made remotely accessible to study participants.

paper1_text: While determining relevance in retrieval systems is inherently complex and depends on users' dynamic writing objectives, querying based on semantic similarity in text vector space is an established approach in retrieval-based systems [47]. Our initial implementation explored hybrid search techniques, following prior work that used Reciprocal Rank Fusion [41] to combine keyword-based and vector-based retrieval results. However, through initial experiments, we found pure vector-based search provided more contextually relevant matches.
